_note: Customer email, in the customer's voice, and the staff reply. Slots: {name} {first} {order} {product} {days}. The deriver joins greeting + body + optional extra + closer, so a dozen of each gives hundreds of different mails. Plain, polite, ordinary people.
closers: I'd be grateful for a reply.

reply_greetings: Dear {first}, thank you for your email.

where_is_my_order: I have looked at {order}. It is in hand and I will write again as soon as it moves.
Thank you for asking. I've checked {order} and the tracking page is the most up to date place to look; I have also asked the carrier directly.
I can see {order} on our side. I'll follow it up today and tell you what I find.
{order} is with us and being dealt with. I will confirm by email once it has left.
I have traced {order}. The latest information is on your order page, and I'll write if it changes.
Sorry for the wait. I've looked at {order} and I'll update you by the end of tomorrow.
I've found {order}. It is moving, just not as quickly as either of us would like.
Thank you. I have checked where {order} is and noted your email on it, so nobody asks you twice.
The order page for {order} is correct. If it hasn't changed by tomorrow I'll chase the carrier myself.
I have looked into it. {order} is on its way, and I'll tell you at once if that stops being true.
late_parcel: I'm sorry {order} is late. I have asked the carrier what happened and will write as soon as I have an answer.
That is later than we promised. I'm chasing {order} today and will update you tomorrow.
Thank you for telling us. I have opened a trace on {order}. If it doesn't turn up we will replace or refund it.
Sorry about the wasted day. I've put a note on {order} so the next person to see it knows.
I've asked the carrier to look for {order}. You do not need to do anything else for now.
I can see the date has passed. I am looking into it and will come back to you.
lost_parcel: I'm sorry. I've opened a trace with the carrier for {order}. If it can't be found we'll send another or refund you, whichever you prefer.
Thank you for checking with your neighbours. I've started a missing parcel claim for {order} and will update you shortly.
That should not happen. I'm dealing with {order} now and will confirm the next step by email.
complaint: I'm sorry to read this. I have logged your complaint about {order} and a person will review it. You'll hear from us within the time in our complaints policy.
Thank you for writing. I have recorded this as a complaint on {order} and passed it to the person who handles them.
I have read your message properly. This is now a formal complaint, and I will confirm the date by which you'll have a full answer.
I'm sorry we've let you down over {order}. I've asked for it to be looked at by a senior member of the team.
I understand why you wrote. Your complaint about {order} is logged, and I'll write again with what we propose.
Thank you for being clear. I'll make sure your complaint is read by someone who can change the outcome.
This is acknowledged and recorded. You do not need to send it again.
I'm sorry. I have taken ownership of this and will update you within the complaint timescale.
presale: Thank you for asking. The product page has the full details, but in short: yes, we can help. If you tell me what you'd use it for I'll say honestly whether it suits.
Good question. The page for {product} lists what's in stock and the likely delivery time; if anything looks unclear, write back.
Thank you. For gifts we can add a note at checkout, and the returns policy covers presents as well.
We deliver across the UK. Delivery cost and time are shown at checkout before you pay.
I've checked the stock. It is shown on the page and is the real figure.
Happy to help. The guarantee for {product} is on its page, with its conditions in a readable size.
Thank you for the careful question. Short answer on the page; longer answer here: it is made to be used, and we'd say so if it weren't.
For larger quantities, write to us with the numbers and the date you need them, and we'll quote.
Thanks for writing before you bought. It's the right way round.
product_question: Thank you. The care and use notes for {product} are on its page, and I have copied the relevant part below in case that's easier.
I'd say yes, though I'd like to check one detail. Could you tell me which version of {product} you have?
Spare parts are listed on the page for {product} where they exist. If one isn't listed, write back and I'll ask the bench.
Thanks for spotting that. The instruction sheet is the one to follow; I'll pass your note on so the page is clearer.
That's normal for the first few days, in our experience. If it hasn't changed in a fortnight, write again.
The guarantee details are on the product page and in your order email.
I asked the person who knows {product} best. Their answer is below.
Thank you. You are using it correctly, and there is nothing further you need to do.
Good point, and not covered clearly enough on the page. I've added a note for the team.
Happy to explain. We think about these things at some length, and it's a pleasure when someone asks.
return_question: You can return {product} from {order} using the returns page. It takes about two minutes and prints a label.
Thanks for asking. Returns are accepted within the time on the returns policy; the page for {order} will tell you whether {product} still qualifies.
Postage for a change-of-mind return is taken from the refund. The exact amount is on the returns page, before you confirm.
I've looked at {order}. A return is possible, and I've started it for you. A label will come by email.
The refund is sent when the parcel has been checked, usually within a few days of arriving. You'll get an email.
Swaps are done as a return and a new order, so nothing is held up while you wait.
We have your parcel. It has been logged and the refund is in hand.
change_order: I've looked at {order}. If it hasn't been packed, I can change it, and I'll confirm as soon as it's done.
Thank you for writing quickly. I've updated the address on {order} and added a note so it isn't overwritten.

fault: I'm sorry {product} has gone wrong. Please send a photo if you can; it helps the bench, but isn't required.

Many thanks for the details. Please do not try to fix it yourself yet. I'll write back today.
I can see {order}. Faults inside the guarantee period are put right at no charge, within its conditions.
Sorry for the trouble. Send {product} back using the label on the repairs page, and we'll look at it within a few days of arrival.
I've sent your note to the technician. He is unlikely to be surprised, and will want to see it.
refund_chase: I'm sorry for the wait. I've checked, and the refund for {order} is being processed. It can take a few working days to show on a statement.
Thank you for chasing. I've asked the finance desk to confirm the date for {order} and will write back today.
Your refund has been issued. Banks vary in how fast they show it; if it isn't there in five working days, tell me.
